historical_statement: For an n x n iid uniform sign matrix B_n, P(s_min(B_n) <= t/sqrt(n)) <= t+exp(-Omega(n)) uniformly for t>=0 in the large-n sense. The local 2012-source intake states all sufficiently large n and small t>=0. This is the exact coefficient-one target; the 2002 original authors also formulated a stronger Boolean-perturbation conjecture, so those variants must stay distinct.
